accounts_role_district_check.name: accounts_role_district_check
accounts_role_district_check.value: ("accounts"."role" = 'PRODUCT_OWNER' AND "accounts"."district_id" IS NULL) OR ("accounts"."role" = 'DISTRICT_HOKIM' AND "accounts"."district_id" IS NOT NULL)

operational_issues_scope_district_check.name: operational_issues_scope_district_check
operational_issues_scope_district_check.value: ("operational_issues"."scope" = 'GLOBAL' AND "operational_issues"."district_id" IS NULL) OR ("operational_issues"."scope" = 'DISTRICT' AND "operational_issues"."district_id" IS NOT NULL)
